verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CIPO has an account-based sign-in ('Log in to MyCIPO Patents') and online filing services. Nothing in the pack describes the authentication method: credential-based MFA, remote completion, or the absence of biometric liveness, in-person visits, or mailed PINs. Login existence alone does not evidence the story's capability, so the applicable axis gets none.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
